verses.english: “Mendicants, desire and greed for the eye,
or mind is a corruption of the mind.

verses.pali: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti, nekkhammaninnañcassa cittaṁ hoti.
verses.english: When a mendicant has given up mental corruption in these six cases, their mind inclines to renunciation.

verses.pali: Nekkhammaparibhāvitaṁ cittaṁ kammaniyaṁ khāyati, abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū”ti.
verses.english: A mind imbued with renunciation is said to be fit for work regarding anything that can be realized by insight.”
